title: Ginkgo Nuts and Ginseng Chicken Soup
ldName: Ginkgo Nuts and Ginseng Chicken Soup
ldIngredientsRaw: 1 free range chicken (Indonesian: ayam kampung), cut into 4-8 pieces
ldInstructionsRaw: Rinse and drain all the dried herbs to remove dust and dirt.
Place all ingredients in a soup pot and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 1 hour or until chicken is tender and fully cooked.
Remove from heat and serve warm.
